d: Honey-blonde hair falls in long, straight waves with a center part, framing a mature face with narrow, amber-colored eyes. The build is broad-shouldered and muscular, encased in polished silver plate armor with gold accents, featuring a high gorget, heavy pauldrons, and a gold-trimmed fauld over a dark navy cape. Accessories include a silver circlet with a central gem, a massive ornate silver shield with gold diamond motifs, and a tall silver staff topped with a sun-burst ornament.
